006package dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter;
007
008import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.jsonFormatVisitors.JsonFormatTypes;
009
010import org.apache.commons.codec.BinaryDecoder;
011import org.apache.commons.codec.BinaryEncoder;
012import org.apache.commons.codec.DecoderException;
013import org.apache.commons.codec.EncoderException;
014
015import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
016import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
017import java.util.Arrays;
018
019import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.AbstractDataTypeAdapter;
020import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
021import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.AbstractAtomicOrUnionType;
022import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
023import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
024
025/**
026 * Maintains a byte buffer representation of a byte stream.
027 * <p>
028 * The maintained byte stream is kept in a decoded form.
029 *
030 * @param <ITEM_TYPE>
031 *          the metapath item type supported by the adapter
032 */
033public abstract class AbstractBinaryAdapter<ITEM_TYPE extends IAnyAtomicItem>
034    extends AbstractDataTypeAdapter<ByteBuffer, ITEM_TYPE> {
035
036  /**
037   * Construct a new Java type adapter for a provided class.
038   *
039   * @param itemClass
040   *          the Java type of the Matepath item this adapter supports
041   * @param castExecutor
042   *          the method to call to cast an item to an item based on this type
043   */
044  protected AbstractBinaryAdapter(
045      @NonNull Class<ITEM_TYPE> itemClass,
046      @NonNull AbstractAtomicOrUnionType.ICastExecutor<ITEM_TYPE> castExecutor) {
047    super(ByteBuffer.class, itemClass, castExecutor);
048  }
049
050  /**
051   * Get the binary decoder to use to decode encoded data.
052   *
053   * @return the decoder
054   */
055  @NonNull
056  protected abstract BinaryDecoder getDecoder();
057
058  /**
059   * Get the binary encoder to use to encode data.
060   *
061   * @return the encoder
062   */
063  @NonNull
064  protected abstract BinaryEncoder getEncoder();
065
066  /**
067   * Get the raw bytes, encoded as UTF8, for the provided text string.
068   *
069   * @param text
070   *          the text string to get the bytes for
071   * @return the UTF8 encoded bytes for the text string
072   */
073  @NonNull
074  private static byte[] stringToBytes(@NonNull String text) {
075    return ObjectUtils.notNull(text.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
076  }
077
078  /**
079   * Get a text string based on the provided raw bytes, encoded as UTF8.
080   *
081   * @param bytes
082   *          a byte array encoded as UTF8
083   * @return the decoded text string
084   */
085  @NonNull
086  private static String bytesToString(@NonNull byte[] bytes) {
087    return new String(bytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
088  }
089
090  private static String elide(@NonNull String text, int length) {
091    return text.length() <= length ? text : text.substring(0, length) + "…";
092  }
093
094  /**
095   * Encode the provided bytes using the encoding supported by this class.
096   *
097   * @param decodedBytes
098   *          the bytes to encode
099   * @return the encoded bytes
100   * @see #getEncoder()
101   */
102  @NonNull
103  public byte[] encode(@NonNull byte[] decodedBytes) {
104    try {
105      return ObjectUtils.notNull(getEncoder().encode(decodedBytes));
106    } catch (EncoderException ex) {
107      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
108          String.format("unable to encode text '%s'", elide(bytesToString(decodedBytes), 64)),
109          ex);
110    }
111  }
112
113  /**
114   * Encode the provided bytes using the encoding supported by this class.
115   *
116   * @param decodedBuffer
117   *          a buffer containing the bytes to encode
118   * @return a buffer containing the encoded bytes
119   * @see #getEncoder()
120   */
121  @NonNull
122  public ByteBuffer encodeToByteBuffer(@NonNull ByteBuffer decodedBuffer) {
123    byte[] decodedBytes = bufferToBytes(decodedBuffer, false);
124    return encodeToByteBuffer(decodedBytes);
125  }
126
127  /**
128   * Encode the provided string using the encoding supported by this class.
129   * <p>
130   * The provided string is first encoded as a stream of UTF8 bytes.
131   *
132   * @param decodedText
133   *          the string to encode
134   * @return a buffer containing the encoded bytes
135   * @see #getEncoder()
136   */
137  @NonNull
138  public ByteBuffer encodeToByteBuffer(@NonNull String decodedText) {
139    byte[] decodedBytes = stringToBytes(decodedText);
140    return encodeToByteBuffer(decodedBytes);
141  }
142
143  /**
144   * Encode the provided bytes using the encoding supported by this class.
145   *
146   * @param decodedBytes
147   *          the bytes to encode
148   * @return a buffer containing the encoded bytes
149   * @see #getEncoder()
150   */
151  @NonNull
152  public ByteBuffer encodeToByteBuffer(@NonNull byte[] decodedBytes) {
153    byte[] encodedBytes = encode(decodedBytes);
154    return ObjectUtils.notNull(ByteBuffer.wrap(encodedBytes));
155  }
156
157  /**
158   * Decode the provided bytes using the encoding supported by this class.
159   *
160   * @param enodedBytes
161   *          the bytes to decode
162   * @return the decoded bytes
163   * @see #getDecoder()
164   */
165  @NonNull
166  public byte[] decode(@NonNull byte[] enodedBytes) {
167    try {
168      return ObjectUtils.notNull(getDecoder().decode(enodedBytes));
169    } catch (DecoderException ex) {
170      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
171          String.format("unable to decode text '%s'", elide(bytesToString(enodedBytes), 64)),
172          ex);
173    }
174  }
175
176  /**
177   * Decode the provided bytes using the encoding supported by this class.
178   *
179   * @param encodedBuffer
180   *          a buffer containing the the bytes to decode
181   * @return a buffer containing the decoded bytes
182   * @see #getDecoder()
183   */
184  @NonNull
185  public ByteBuffer decode(@NonNull ByteBuffer encodedBuffer) {
186    byte[] encodedBytes = bufferToBytes(encodedBuffer, false);
187    byte[] decodedBytes = decode(encodedBytes);
188    return ObjectUtils.notNull(ByteBuffer.wrap(decodedBytes));
189  }
190
191  /**
192   * Decode the provided bytes using the encoding supported by this class.
193   * <p>
194   * The decoded bytes are decoded as a stream of UTF8 bytes to produce the
195   * string.
196   *
197   * @param encodedBytes
198   *          the bytes to decode
199   * @return the decoded string
200   * @see #getDecoder()
201   */
202  @NonNull
203  public String decodeToString(@NonNull byte[] encodedBytes) {
204    byte[] decodedBytes = decode(encodedBytes);
205    return bytesToString(decodedBytes);
206  }
207
208  /**
209   * Decodes the provided string.
210   *
211   * @return a buffer containing the decoded bytes
212   */
213  @Override
214  public ByteBuffer parse(String encodedString) {
215    byte[] encodedBytes = stringToBytes(encodedString);
216    // byte[] decodedBytes = decode(encodedBytes);
217    // return ObjectUtils.notNull(ByteBuffer.wrap(decodedBytes));
218    return ObjectUtils.notNull(ByteBuffer.wrap(encodedBytes));
219  }
220
221  /**
222   * Get the wrapped value as a base64 encoded string.
223   * <p>
224   * Encodes the wrapped value to produce a string.
225   *
226   * @return the base64 encoded value
227   */
228  @Override
229  public String asString(Object encodedBuffer) {
230    byte[] encodedBytes = bufferToBytes((ByteBuffer) encodedBuffer, false);
231    return new String(encodedBytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
232    // return bytesToString(encodedBytes);
233
234    // byte[] decodedBytes = bufferToBytes((ByteBuffer) decodedBuffer, false);
235    // byte[] encodedBytes = encode(decodedBytes);
236    // return bytesToString(encodedBytes);
237  }
238
239  @Override
240  public JsonFormatTypes getJsonRawType() {
241    return JsonFormatTypes.STRING;
242  }
243
244  @Override
245  public ByteBuffer copy(Object obj) {
246    ByteBuffer buffer = (ByteBuffer) obj;
247    ByteBuffer clone = buffer.isDirect()
248        ? ByteBuffer.allocateDirect(buffer.capacity())
249        : ByteBuffer.allocate(buffer.capacity());
250    ByteBuffer readOnlyCopy = buffer.asReadOnlyBuffer();
251    readOnlyCopy.flip();
252    clone.put(readOnlyCopy);
253    return clone;
254  }
255
256  /**
257   * Get the array of bytes stored in the buffer.
258   *
259   * @param buffer
260   *          the buffer
261   * @param copy
262   *          if {@code true} ensure the resulting array is a copy
263   * @return the array of bytes
264   */
265  @NonNull
266  public static byte[] bufferToBytes(@NonNull ByteBuffer buffer, boolean copy) {
267    byte[] array;
268    if (buffer.hasArray()) {
269      array = buffer.array();
270      if (copy) {
271        array = Arrays.copyOf(array, array.length);
272      }
273    } else {
274      // Handle direct buffers
275      array = new byte[buffer.remaining()];
276      buffer.mark();
277      try {
278        buffer.get(array);
279      } finally {
280        buffer.reset();
281      }
282    }
283    return ObjectUtils.notNull(array);
284  }
285}
